title: Unbounded numbers of inequivalent degree-four-d-zero polarizations on complex projective K3 surfaces for odd cube-free d-zero
author: Daniel Huybrechts
work: Finiteness of polarized K3 surfaces and hyperkähler manifolds
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 1 (2018), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.6
difficulty_reason: The explicit construction transfers growing imaginary quadratic class groups through genus equivalence of ternary lattices into Neron–Severi lattices of K3 surfaces, then distinguishes ample classes through orthogonal complements. Its arithmetic-to-period realization and automorphism-orbit argument exceeds ordinary qualifying algebraic geometry.

primary_locator.author_location: Section1.5, original prose construction, not a numbered theorem

source_scope_note: The selected problem is the construction in Section 1.5: unbounded numbers of inequivalent degree 4d0 polarizations on complex projective K3 surfaces, for each fixed positive odd cube-free d0. It is originally stated and proved in prose, not as a numbered theorem. The complete author body retains the moduli/orbit notation and entire construction using growing quadratic class groups, genus-equivalent ternary lattices, distinct orthogonal complements, K3 period realization and ample-class/automorphism-orbit separation. Named Siegel, Gauss principal-genus, ternary-genus and K3 period results remain explicit prerequisites; finiteness, metric, twistor, Kuga--Satake and Fourier--Mukai assertions are unchanged unselected context.
